title: Registry companion 1.1.0: bounds
description: Released on registry-v1.1.0 with spec/registry-1.1.0.md, which governs where they differ. A bounds document (section 6.1), closed at every level: per kind, entry counts and fields, each a bound of section 6.2's rows with optional per-environment bounds (section 6.4). A bounds document the schema refuses is FED-BOUND-FORM, or FED-BOUND-NOT-COMPARABLE for a keyword of registry section 3.2's table in a bound.
$comment: The reader's to check: that kinds are sorted by kind and each appears once, that fields are sorted by pointer and each appears once, that only the standard's bounds state maxAssemblyEntries, that a bounded kind is governed or pinned and a pointer reachable (section 6.1), that a per-environment member names an environment the manifest names and the repository serves (section 6.4), every comparison of sections 6.2 to 6.5, and the bound of 256 KiB.
